notes.title: HUGE DEMO UPDATE: Smarter Colonists, New UI, and Faster Controls!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423482/8284088d52465c0e064eae07d224244afb4afaa1.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]HUGE DEMO UPDATE[/b]! [/h1][p][/p][h2][b]GAMEPLAY:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Smarter Everything:[/b] Mechs, Marsects, and Colonists have all gotten brain upgrades. They’re smarter now.   [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]UI:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Dome UI Overhaul:[/b] Click the Dome icon on the Dome (or use the left-hand Dome icons) to instantly bring up the Dome panel. Managing your colony just got smoother.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Dome Naming:[/b] You can now edit and personalize your Dome names! “Home Sweet Dome!”  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]UI Windows:[/b] Click the X icon to close any window.  [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]CONTROLS:[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Mech Commands:[/b] Right-click to command your Mechs to move (no longer left-click).  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Rapid Build:[/b] Hold Shift + Left-click to place the same thing multiple times, no need to reopen the panel.  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Faster Controls:[/b] Zooming in and out with your mouse wheel is now [i]way[/i] faster. Navigate Mars like a pro. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Try it out now and tell us what you think! Share your screenshots, Dome names, and chaos in ⁠[b]Discord! [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]And if you can, please show some love on our Kickstarter![/b][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyborgdreams/mars-the-last-exodus-when-colony-sim-meets-rts"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyborgdreams/mars-the-last-exodus-when-colony-sim-meets-rts[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423482/2b283e973161f6cc9621d1438936072a67482e79.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423482/bc942b4a9cf33128077327998c80c1f2610d55d2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423482/0b3b4c2d103e54ad09d6b5644f0d14f2dcd99143.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Official Trailer Soundtrack Release
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423482/199ce8cd63a358e6139f1f3ac4f4ce13392ccdff.png"][/img][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vLLmMYulSA" style="button" buttoncolor="#00ce77"]Official Trailer Soundtrack[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The official trailer soundtrack of MARS: The Last Exodus.[/p][p]Composed by Josh Kashdan ([url="https://www.kashdanmusic.com/"]https://www.kashdanmusic.com/[/url]), this piece captures the tension of survival, the thrill of mech combat, and the hope of building a new life on Mars.[/p][p][/p][p]🎧 Listen to the full track above. Tell us your favorite part![/p][p][/p][p]🛰️ Support us on Kickstarter: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyborgdreams/mars-the-last-exodus-when-colony-sim-meets-rts"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyborgdreams/mars-the-last-exodus-when-colony-sim-meets-rts[/url][/p][p][/p][p]🚀 Wishlist on Steam: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166630/MARS_The_Last_Exodus"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Update on the Second Playtest!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Marsnauts, [/p][p][/p][p]Great news, the playtest has been extended until [b]Sunday, July 13th at 23:59 UTC![/b][/p][p][/p][p]That means more time to play, and we’d really appreciate it if you could share your thoughts in the feedback form in-game or in the #⁠feedback-form channel on Discord![/p][p][/p][p]And a fun new feature just landed! When you hit [b]“Recruit”[/b], you can now customize your colonists' outfits! [b]Side effect?[/b] Some of the colonists didn’t get the memo and showed up… without clothes. [/p][p][/p][p]This is an early implementation of the "Recruit" customization. [/p][p]In the meantime, please enjoy this “Bare Essentials” Edition. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423482/504dfd36c1fcf0ec2f3a6e398d46a3de6b14ebde.png"][/img][/p]
